title: 2000 FA Cup final
displaytitle: 2000 FA Cup final

titles.display: 2000 FA Cup final

extract: The 2000 FA Cup final was the 119th final of the FA Cup, and the 72nd and last to be played at the old Wembley Stadium. It took place on 20 May 2000 and was contested between Chelsea and Aston Villa, the latter making its first FA Cup Final appearance since winning it in 1957.
